response: Yes, pelvic anatomical structures are in danger during arthroscopic acetabular labral repair. It is anatomically possible that some pelvic structures can sustain iatrogenic injury during acetabular drilling for anchor placement. To minimize this risk, being aware of the mean pelvic vault is important, as excessive pincer rim trimming can decrease the depth of acetabular bone. Careful drilling using a stopped drill bit is crucial to prevent iatrogenic injury. Therefore, surgeons should exercise caution when performing this procedure to avoid damaging surrounding pelvic structures.
